characters.name: 플레이어
characters.prompt:
Create ONE square framed experimental pixel-art portrait. INPUT1 is the ONLY character/pose/costume source. INPUT2 is ONLY the approved coarseness and mixed-resolution rendering style. Never copy input2's character, colors, facing direction, blindfold, grass or hairstyle.

REBUILD THE INTERIOR as an intentionally authored EXTREMELY LOW RESOLUTION 20x20-target game icon, enlarged to fill the inner frame, matching or slightly exceeding input2's huge block size. This is the 64-target version. It is NOT automatic mosaic/downsampling, not a fine pixel portrait with a grid effect. Design the big silhouette and flat color clusters anew. Facial detail and small accessories MUST be sacrificed to make the coarse scale readable.
64-TARGET: roughly 20 columns and20 rows across the entire interior. Face about5–6 logical cells across, eye at most1–2 dark blocks, mouth at most one short block, no eyelashes, nostril details, tiny scars, pupils or hair strands. Big skin light/shadow clusters and broad armor/cloth shapes. The approved style image gives the degree of coarseness; do not make smaller/finer pixels than it.

CHARACTER: Neutral adult traveler. Wide shallow grey STEEL KETTLE HAT sits LOW, its straight brim hides BOTH EYES completely. The face beneath is a simple warm skin cluster and short neutral mouth. No visible eyes, no red glow, no raised brim. Brown hair barely at sides. CREAM/OFF-WHITE padded gambeson with dark brown leather X straps across chest. The silver-grey hat, hidden eyes, cream outfit and brown X are the identity.
VIEW/COMPOSITION: EXACTLY FRONT FACING, centered, symmetric head and shoulders. Keep this front view; do not turn him three-quarter. Preserve the head/upper-chest placement, size and source framing; do not zoom out or enlarge the canvas. No invented or extra accessories.
Inside the frame use only roughly8–12 broad flat colors, hard square staircase edges, no gradients, tiny texture, dithering or fine outline thinner than one logical cell. Plain warm ivory background. The face remains an adult's symbolic portrait, not a new chibi character.

FRAME RULE: The character interior is coarse but the OUTER FRAME must stay at ORIGINAL HIGH RESOLUTION, exactly the fine FRAME1 appearance of input1: thin double straight metallic gold lines, layered beveled small SQUARE corner ornaments, delicate highlights/shadows and dark brown margin. All four full corners. DO NOT pixelate, simplify, enlarge or blur this frame. Fine detailed physical frame surrounding a huge-block icon, like the approved mixed-resolution style in input2. No text, labels or visible grid lines. Output one square original-resolution PNG around1254px.
characters.visualReview: Front-facing centered pose and low steel kettle hat conceal both eyes. Cream gambeson/brown X straps retained; no red glow.128 has fewer hat/facial/clothing clusters than64.
